title: Offline fixture envelope
description: Versioned envelope for deterministic offline fixtures shared by Rust, Python, and TypeScript tests. TEST-01 loaders must read this format; they must not invent a second envelope.

schema.description: Contract name matching a packages/schemas/<name>.v<major>.json file stem.

schema_version.description: Major.minor of the embedded contract; the envelope loader resolves it to <name>.v<major>.json.

prompt.description: Present when the expected output was produced by a prompt pipeline; the version participates in cache keys and golden case selection.

input.description: Deterministic input instance; must satisfy the contract named above.

expected.description: Golden expected output; optional for input-only fixtures. Must satisfy the same contract family when present.

stable_fields.description: Fields compared byte-for-byte in golden checks.

volatile_fields.description: Fields normalized (dropped or placeholdered) before golden comparison; e.g. timestamps and generated IDs.
